# `auth/session`

<!-- Generated by `pnpm build:docs`. Do not edit by hand. -->

Cookie-session auth for Express: signed session middleware, bcrypt hashing and a guard.

**Provides:** `auth`, `auth:session`

**Requires:** `http:express`, `config:env`

**Conflicts with:** `auth`

## Files it writes

- `src/lib/password.ts` (when `provides('language:typescript')`)
- `src/lib/password.js` (when `provides('language:javascript')`)
- `src/middlewares/auth.ts` (when `provides('language:typescript')`)
- `src/middlewares/auth.js` (when `provides('language:javascript')`)
- `src/types/session.d.ts` (when `provides('language:typescript')`)

## Dependencies

- `express-session@^1.18.2`
- `bcryptjs@^3.0.2`

Development only:

- `@types/express-session@^1.18.2` (when `provides('language:typescript')`)
- `@types/bcryptjs@^3.0.0` (when `provides('language:typescript')`)

## Environment

| Variable | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `SESSION_SECRET` | yes | Key used to sign the session cookie; at least 32 characters |

## What it contributes to other files

| File | Slot | Line |
|---|---|---|
| `src/config/env.ts\|js` | `env-schema` | `SESSION_SECRET: z.string().min(32, 'SESSION_SECRET must be at least 32 characters'),` |
| `src/app.ts\|js` | `imports` | `import session from 'express-session';` |
| `src/app.ts\|js` | `imports` | `import { env } from './config/env.js';` |
| `src/app.ts\|js` | `middleware` | `app.use(` |

## Use it

```bash
atarashi new my-app --add auth/session
atarashi add auth/session
```
